requirement.text: The THEMAS system shall maintain the ON/OFF status of each heating and cooling unit.

classification.rationale: The requirement describes maintaining the ON/OFF status of physical heating and cooling units within a thermal management control system (THEMAS). Neither the target requirement nor the surrounding document references web applications, mobile apps, or machine learning, making 'other' (embedded/control system) the appropriate classification.

rounds.text_checked: The THEMAS system shall maintain the ON/OFF status of each heating and cooling unit.

test_strategy.rationale: The requirement specifies maintaining discrete ON/OFF statuses for heating and cooling units, which represents system states and transitions between them (state_based). Additionally, testing against valid status values (ON, OFF) and invalid status inputs applies equivalence partitioning.

test_cases.title: Verify valid status partitions (ON and OFF) for heating and cooling units
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is operational with registered heating unit H1 and cooling unit C1.
steps: Set heating unit H1 status to ON in THEMAS.
Query THEMAS system for H1 status.
Set cooling unit C1 status to OFF in THEMAS.
Query THEMAS system for C1 status.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS successfully records and maintains status 'ON' for H1 and 'OFF' for C1.

test_cases.title: Verify rejection of invalid status inputs outside valid equivalence partition
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS system is operational with registered heating unit H1 currently set to OFF.
steps: Attempt to update H1 status with an invalid string value 'STANDBY'.
Query THEMAS system for H1 status.
Attempt to update H1 status with a null/empty value.
Query THEMAS system for H1 status.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS rejects both invalid status updates with appropriate error responses and maintains the prior valid status ('OFF') for H1.

test_cases.title: Verify state transitions between OFF and ON for heating unit
test_cases.preconditions: Heating unit H1 is in the OFF state within THEMAS.
steps: Trigger transition event to switch H1 state from OFF to ON.
Verify maintained status of H1 in THEMAS.
Trigger transition event to switch H1 state from ON to OFF.
Verify maintained status of H1 in THEMAS.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS accurately updates and maintains state to ON after step 1, and back to OFF after step 3.

test_cases.title: Verify independent state maintenance across multiple heating and cooling units
test_cases.preconditions: THEMAS has heating units H1, H2 and cooling units C1, C2 registered.
steps: Initialize statuses: H1=ON, H2=OFF, C1=OFF, C2=ON.
Transition H1 from ON to OFF while keeping H2, C1, C2 static.
Query the maintained state of all four units from THEMAS.
test_cases.expected_result: THEMAS maintains independent states for each unit: H1 is OFF, H2 is OFF, C1 is OFF, and C2 is ON.

final_text: The THEMAS system shall maintain the ON/OFF status of each heating and cooling unit.
